name: cursor
title: Cursor
description: An animated mouse pointer that follows a scripted path to a button, clicks it with a ripple, and the button shows hover, press, loading and success.
useWhen: A product demo needs a pointer guiding the eye and clicking a control.
Showing a click with a ripple and a press dip.
avoidWhen: You need a scripted path across a whole scene with several targets: place the cursor as an overlay in your own timeline.
A text insertion point: use caret.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Ripple color
variables.description: Click ripple color. Empty uses the theme primary.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Text of the button the pointer clicks.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
